description.text: The ninth and last expansion pack of the BW series, released on 15 March 2013. Genesect, from the film Genesect and the Legend Awakened, made its card debut here on the wrapper as Genesect-EX, a Team Plasma Pokémon too. With Dialga-EX, Palkia-EX, Virizion-EX and Jirachi-EX it holds five Pokémon-EX, more than any single BW pack before it, and many cards meant to keep the growing Team Plasma cards in check. The cards are numbered to 76. In English it became Plasma Blast in August 2013.
